title: Macro-Policy Interactions with VAR
analytical_question: How do inflation, policy rates, FX depreciation, and bond yields interact over time?
learning_objectives: Understand why VAR uses multiple variables
Recognize instability risks in short samples

concepts.name: VAR
concepts.plain_english: VAR models several variables together and allows each variable to depend on its own past values and the past values of other variables.

concepts.name: Impulse response
concepts.plain_english: An impulse response traces how a shock to one variable may be followed by movements in other variables.

review_questions: Is the lag length reasonable for the frequency?
Are there enough observations for the number of variables?
Do the impulse responses make economic sense?
